headline: Goat Ledger Catastrophe: Local Electrical Fire Sparks Nationwide Favor Panic
deck: Residents scramble as DMV announces temporary goat-favor moratorium; favor-recall clock begins ticking.
article:
A minor electrical fire at the Dastardly County Records Office has put thirty years of goat-IOU ledgers at risk, forcing the DMV to freeze all favor trades. Residents who built their social calendars around sheep swaps and chicken debts now face a 48-hour recall window.

Martha Pemberton, a local chicken herder, said she was ready to exchange three bushels of corn for a promised goat when the freeze hit. Her neighbor countered with a demand for a llama instead.

Fiddlesticks County offered three chickens plus a lawn-mower tune-up for duplicate copies. Mayor Barnaby Featherfield called the move a chance to strengthen his own goat holdings while the Dastardly ledgers remain in doubt.
author: Bertie Ledgerwood, Senior Correspondent

oped.title: Moratorium Mania: Why Panic Serves the Greater Ledger
oped.author: Professor Alistair Quibbleton, PhD in Goat Reciprocity and Unlicensed Hat Inspector
oped.body: The Goat Ledger Catastrophe amounts to collective hysteria from citizens overly attached to their scribbled IOUs. The DMV freeze wisely stops reckless trading before worse fires start, and the electrical mishap did everyone a service by clearing bloated accounts. Residents should quit scrambling and thank the clerks for restoring order. My own unrepaid goat debts will simply vanish, sparing me the chore of delivering three kids to the neighbor whose wide-brimmed hat always hinted at sloppy bookkeeping. A nationwide recall clock marks real progress; fewer goats should change hands, and more citizens should accept that stability rests on one-sided debts that quietly reward the careful.

classifieds.text: FOR SALE: Three unledgored goats and a wheelbarrow of blank favor chits. DMV fire torched my records; selling before the recall clock claims my entire herd.

HELP WANTED: Temporary favor auditor needed to rebuild my goat ledger after the electrical meltdown. Must work fast—moratorium ends in six days and my neighbor already filed a recall on the 2024 lawn-mowing debt.
LOST: Handwritten IOU for one goat owed on a 2025 scooter repair. If recovered, contact immediately; the nationwide panic has half the block claiming it belongs to them instead.

LEGAL NOTICE: All parties holding my 2023-2025 favor notes are hereby notified of a temporary suspension pending DMV audit. Electric fire destroyed backups; please do not attempt goat collection until the moratorium lifts.

panels.caption: Electrical fire torches the central goat ledger. 'Twelve years of favors, erased in smoke!'
DMV chief at podium: 'Temporary goat-favor moratorium. The recall clock starts ticking tonight.'
Neighbor leans in: 'Excellent. You still owe me that goat for the roof in '24.'

stories.headline: Retail Chains Halt Employee Goat Swaps Over DMV Freeze
stories.deck: National chains convert break rooms into manual ledger audit stations as unpaid favors pile up.
stories.article:
Retailers have paused internal barter programs while the DMV holds goat favors in limbo. Managers now demand handwritten notes for every shift trade once logged as three goats or one mowing debt.

Central databases show 11,800 uncleared entries since the moratorium. The yearly goat-allocation review has been pushed to the next quarter.

stories.headline: Ledger Theft at County Fair Leaves 200 Barter Debts in Dispute
stories.deck: Investigators trace missing pages to a single unpaid chicken coop favor from 2023.
stories.article:
Deputies are probing the theft of a goat ledger from the Midland County Fair office. Two hundred entries covering livestock and services from last month's demolition derby and pie contest disappeared overnight.

Without the book, residents cannot settle claims such as four goats for a tractor repair. Suspects have been narrowed to three names that appear often on surviving pages.
